latest.title: Nonnegative curvature on vector bundles over ${CP}^3$ and its blow-up
latest.abstract: Every real vector bundle of rank at least seven over $CP^3$, or every real vector bundle of rank at least eight over $CP^3\#CP^3$, admits a complete metric of nonnegative sectional curvature on its total space. The corresponding unit sphere bundles also admit nonnegative sectional curvature. These are fixed-rank results: no additional trivial summand is required, and there is no restriction on any characteristic class. The proof combines low-dimensional bundle classification with the Grove--Ziller lifting theory over $S^4$ and $CP^2$.
latest.workSummary: 证明 CP3 上实秩至少七、CP3#CP3 上至少八的任意实向量丛总空间及单位球丛可带非负截面曲率。
latest.breakthrough: 在固定秩且无特征类限制下给出非负曲率存在性。
latest.limitations: 秩阈值与底流形必须保留，不表示所有向量丛总空间均可行。 已补读所列正文片段；这不是逐行独立证明审查。
latest.priorityReason: 非负截面曲率构造与拓扑直接相关。
